```yaml
name: Publish

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt
        pip install pytest

    - name: Run tests
      run: pytest

    - name: Format SOQL/SOSL queries with CSV output
      run: |
        # Example command to format SOQL/SOSL queries with CSV output
        python format_queries.py --format csv

    - name: Strip attributes metadata from Salesforce responses
      run: |
        # Example command to strip attributes metadata
        python strip_attributes.py

    - name: Commit changes
      run: |
        git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
        git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
        git add .
        git commit -m "Optimize token usage and update test suite"

    - name: Push changes
      uses: ad-m/github-push-action@v0.6.0
      with:
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        branch: main
```
